summary: Z Squared Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a First Amendment to its binding letter of intent to acquire 100% of Skycore Digital LLC from MN Data Centers JV LLC and Claw Holdings LLC. The amendment extends the drop-dead date to January 15, 2027, eliminates the $500,000 break-up fee, terminates exclusivity, and makes the LOI non-binding except for confidentiality and dispute resolution. No board recommendation or advisor named. There is no certainty a definitive agreement will be signed. Watch for whether a binding definitive agreement emerges or the deal lapses.
